title: The kit-not-installed remedy names the package route
summary: `IA-CORE-KIT-NOT-INSTALLED` now leads its remedy with `ia install --package <name> --apply --yes` and names `@inventarch/public-kits`, where the public kits ship, because `ia install <id>` reaches only a registry release and refuses the public kits. `ia install <id> --apply --yes` is kept for kits a registry serves, and the plugin route reads `kit.mjs add <id> --apply`. The code, the `kit` field and when the refusal fires are unchanged; only the message text differs.
